# `candid negotiate`

Negotiation playbook, scripts, counter drafts.

## Usage

```
usage: python -m candid negotiate [-h] <subcommand> ...
```

## Subcommands

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| `playbook` | Show the negotiation playbook. |
| `script` | Get a script for a specific scenario. |
| `counter` | Draft a counter-offer email. |


### `candid negotiate playbook`

Show the negotiation playbook.

```
usage: python -m candid negotiate playbook [-h]
```

### `candid negotiate script`

Get a script for a specific scenario.

```
usage: python -m candid negotiate script [-h] --which {lowball_anchor,competing_offer,exploding_deadline,level_pushback,leveling_up_push,remote_flexibility} [--set SET]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--which` `WHICH` | (required) |
| `--set` `SET` | key=value template fields |


### `candid negotiate counter`

Draft a counter-offer email.

```
usage: python -m candid negotiate counter [-h] --person PERSON --role ROLE --company COMPANY [--location LOCATION] --base-ask BASE_ASK [--second-item SECOND_ITEM] [--second-ask SECOND_ASK] [--target TARGET] [--call-time CALL_TIME]
```

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--person` `PERSON` | (required) |
| `--role` `ROLE` | (required) |
| `--company` `COMPANY` | (required) |
| `--location` `LOCATION` | - |
| `--base-ask` `BASE_ASK` | (required) |
| `--second-item` `SECOND_ITEM` | (default: Sign-on bonus) |
| `--second-ask` `SECOND_ASK` | - |
| `--target` `TARGET` | - |
| `--call-time` `CALL_TIME` | (default: tomorrow) |
